220000.description:
Elizabeth, a villainess whose poor social skills kept her from escaping condemnation, is chosen as a sacrifice to the Demon King. On the verge of being eaten, she shouts out the dream she couldn't fulfill in her previous life, becoming a chef: "Eat my cooking!" In the Demon King's castle, where not a single crop will grow, she is assigned to an "employee cafeteria" on the brink of closing! She resolves to win over the stomachs of the inscrutable Demon King and the fearsome demons with knowledge from her past life and warm food. But just when things seem to be going well, radicals who hate humans stand in her way...?

A demon-world gourmet fantasy in which a socially awkward young lady devoted to cooking starts a revolution through the stomach!

(Source: Corona EX, translated)

title.native: 魔王城の絶品社食、作っているのは生贄です！@COMIC
title.romaji: Maou-jou no Zeppin Shashoku, Tsukutte Iru no wa Ikenie desu! @COMIC

220001.description:
The year is 20xx. The Japanese government, struggling with labor shortages, creates highly intelligent life forms called "Cobitons." A pilot program begins in City S, using them as labor replacements and family members. The Cobitons function smoothly and prove useful to the people. However, an unprecedented earthquake strikes the region, rendering them uncontrollable. They begin to run amok, unleashing a horrific slaughter. In this desperate situation, college student Jinya rises up to fight for survival! A groundbreaking survival suspense story!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

220002.description:
"I finally managed to get it all the way in!" In a world where beastfolk and humans coexist peacefully, Hinako is a human woman married to the aloof wolfman Soshiro through an arranged marriage. Unsure how to bridge the distance between them, she takes a bold step and applies for "mating leave," paid time off meant to accommodate a beastfolk's mating period. Summoning all her courage, she tells Soshiro that she wants to spend a passionate night in his arms. In response, he bares the fangs he had always kept hidden and says, "I've been holding back all this time, so you'd better prepare yourself." With that, he unleashes a fiery passion beyond anything she had ever dreamed of. "No way, it's getting even bigger!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.english: Mating Leave: My Beastman Husband's Insatiable Rut
title.native: 交配休暇~獣人夫の本気の発情が止まらない
title.romaji: Kouhai Kyuuka: Juujin Otto no Honki no Hatsujou ga Tomaranai

220003.description:
Toa was reincarnated as the second son of a noble family while retaining memories of his life on Earth. Although he aimed for a leisurely and comfortable life in another world, he was exiled to a border fort at a young age due to his lack of talent in swordsmanship and magic. Ten years later, following his father’s death, he was called back only to be disowned by his older brother, Grass, who had inherited the family. Undaunted by these harsh circumstances, Toa decided to use the skills and knowledge he acquired at the border fort to become an adventurer. However, after helping a girl named Nikka during the guild’s entrance exam, he becomes entangled in an incident that shakes the royal capital–!? The exhilarating battle fantasy begins, where those who underestimate him will pay double!

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

220005.description:
Despite his tough-guy appearance, Spinel is a rough-and-tumble man who absolutely loves "cute things." Having been imprisoned for certain reasons, he decides to start a new life surrounded by "cute things" upon his release. Together with a fluffy beast he meets in town and a girl from the legendary "Celestial Race," he plans to run a cute "Fluffy Cafe" in his second life—or so he thought, but hard-hitting troubles keep piling up in his lap...!?

(Source: AlphaPolis, translated)

220007.description:
Amid a war between Earth and Jupiter's forces, our protagonist is captured by the enemy while piloting the "Acephale." Refusing to become a prisoner of war, what will he do next...?

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: ノー・マンズ・サテライト

220008.description:
The newest "great detective" of this era is born!! The first official manga adaptation of Hundred Note!! Hercule Poirot, Kogoro Akechi, Sherlock Holmes. Whenever a crime is committed, you can count on a great detective being there. This is the story of the birth of a new great detective.

The year is 20XX. In TOKYO CITY, 100 "great detectives" work under the unified detective organization, Nest, to solve cases. Daichi Tenmei is a high school student whose father was a great detective who also dreams of becoming a great detective himself. Together with Jin Shiba, who posses extraordinary perception and deductive reasoning skills, and Tatehito Kiri, a smug Kansai native who lives for flattery but also cares deeply for his friends, the three travel to a deserted island. However, a single scream turns what was supposed to be a fun trip with classmates into a tragedy.

220011.description:
[If you could only choose one person to live your ideal life with, which would you choose?] Chiho loves her job, and Natsu loves Chiho very much. They are both 156cm tall. They were supposed to be the best of friends because they were the same height, but lately Chiho has been feeling a little cramped when she's with Natsu... Just as Chiho is worried that she might not be able to stay with Natsu anymore, something happens that solves all her worries...!?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

220020.description:
Sakae Itou, a boy captivated by paintings with a unique color palette, meets Kiyoko Sugano—the artist behind a mural in Shinjuku—and finds himself swept up by her distinctive personality… Drawn to Kiyoko, who earnestly declares, “I want to change the world,” Sakae follows her lead and enrolls in a prestigious high school. He then abandons the path that would have secured his future (the respectable art club) and joins a shady club called the Contemporary Art Research Society, where the future looks bleak...? While being pulled along by the woman he admires, he revels in freedom, anguish, and sex among a group of outcasts who couldn’t fit into society. A Johanne Yamamoto-style, left-wing, coming-of-age story!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

220021.description:
Having the person you like by your side makes every day a little more special.

There's the kind and tall official and Kozakura Men, who adores him. Even the fleeting moments when they notice the height difference, the juice they share from the vending machine during lunch break, or the moments when their eyes meet during a long-distance run—these are all precious moments for the two of them.

Even the cool and aloof Hitsuji-chan, when she's alone with her boyfriend Tomo-kun, shares one earphone or secretly peeks at his sleeping face. There's also the yuri couple Aoi and Yoru, who nurture their love in the classroom, and the mischievous underclassman Ama and the stoic senior Kokoro-senpai, and various other couples who blush, get anxious, and get close...

A school romantic comedy that captures the ordinary yet special everyday moments spent with the person you like!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

220028.description:
"Marry me." A political marriage with her childhood friend, with divorce as the inevitable outcome...!?

Aoi is ordered to marry her childhood friend, Togo, in place of her sister who ran away just before their arranged marriage. Togo was Aoi's secret first love, but Togo loves her sister. Confused but accepting for the sake of her family, Aoi tries to accept the marriage. She intends to live as a couple in name only, but the purpose of the political marriage is to produce an heir...!?

(Source: HarperCollinsJapan, translated)

220060.description:
A special membership to the Erebos Hotel, inherited from his mother, who passed away ten years ago. Jess, who wanted to draw the monsters that appeared in his dreams, enters the hotel with high hopes. However, amid bizarre rules and a series of disappearances, the hotel gradually descends into a labyrinth. Amid the chaos, Jess finds himself helplessly drawn to Caiman, a man who is both kind and dangerous.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

220069.description:
When I woke up, I found myself in the world of a romance game as the childhood friend heroine, Suzuna Ametsuki. And the one who appeared before me was lazy, spoiled protagonist… Honestly, I don’t like him. I have no experience with romance, but being the one he’s trying to win over is a bit of a problem. In that case, I’ll just keep breaking romance flags until I’m demoted to a background character.

I’ll leave dating the protagonist to the other girls… Wait, heroine? Aren’t you a little to close? Our skin is touching, and I can even hear your breathing. Um… I’m not your love interest, okay? (Source: no9, translated)

Note: self-published version of Osananajimi no Watashi wa Mob de Itai Noni, Naze ka Heroine no Renai Taishou ni Natteiru. after the manga serialization was cancelled.

220070.description:
Yukiya Tojo is reincarnated into another world by a self-proclaimed “god” and begins a self-sufficient, slow-paced life with help from Gre, a talking spider. But just as he’s settling in, an elf woman wearing revealing, sexy clothes pays him a visit…!?

A cultural exchange begins with a demi-human girl with a wildly lecherous nature!

(Source: Comic Walker, translated)
synonyms: Harem Life With Lewd Demon Girls

title.native: ドスケベ魔族とハーレムライフ
ドスケベ魔族が蔓延る異世界でスローライフを送ろうとしたら、 なぜか知らぬ間に魔王軍の美人幹部たちに気に入られて毎日種付けエッチをするハーレムライフになっていました。

220072.description:
Hirano Fumika, a woman in her late twenties who's been dumped by her boyfriend after being overwhelmed by her demanding job, unexpectedly meets Makoto Sora, a member of the group "Tonari" (Next Door) to her favorite idol, Hasumi Ryusei! She reaches out to him, who's on hiatus due to a scandal and suffering from an illness, and they bond over their shared love for their favorite idol! And under certain conditions, they agree to live together in order to help him make a comeback...!? For the sake of her favorite idol, she'll make him return! The comeback cohabitation comedy with her idol's neighbor begins!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
